title: Experiments: config-driven pipeline + sweeps
description: Add a small config system (YAML/JSON) and a runner (bash/python) to parameterize T/N/R/horizon/quadrature nodes, run multiple scenarios, and emit LaTeX-friendly tables/figures for the paper.

title: Code: true COPF on PLC (Aruoba et al. 2021)
description: Upgrade the current PLC(interp)+EKF-proposal PF proxy into a closer COPF implementation: derive regime-wise linear measurement, sample shocks/next state from the conditional Gaussian (or truncated mixture) exactly where applicable, and report apples-to-apples likelihood/ESS/runtime vs OccBin and PPPF.

title: Code: NK PPPF with anticipated-shock path (omega)
description: Implement PPPF as described in the paper: build reference paths conditional on an anticipated-shock object omega_t (short horizon of future innovations), compute pathwise Jacobians, and integrate omega via a nonnegative-weight quadrature/MC mixture. Update nk_elb.hpp + nk_compare.cpp to use the new transition and rerun experiments.

title: Code/Experiments: add PLC/COPF (Aruoba et al. 2021) baseline
description: Implement a PLC decision-rule approximation and a COPF-style likelihood evaluator for the NK-ELB benchmark, so the paper’s benchmark section includes an Aruoba et al. (2021) comparison alongside OccBin and PPPF. Start with the simple 3-equation NK-ELB and keep outputs compatible with output/nk/*.csv + plots.

title: Code: implement simulation study + analytic tests

description: Turn the benchmark section into a proper simulation study: explain data-generation, compare methods on shared truth model, discuss bias vs variance, and add a short limitations/future-work subsection (e.g., omega dimension, localization refinement, measurement nonlinearity).
